# THE SIGNATURE PC SYSTEM DEPOSITORY — llms.txt

Every computer system, from the most original machines ever built to every
recorded model — and every possible model still to come. Each file ships a
working in-browser simulator, a Signature-made version, and the full story.

Base: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/jah-computer-systems/

## What the counts mean (single source of truth: data/counts.json)

- RECORDED: systems on file — 121 curated seed records + drip-generated records.
- SIGNATURE VERSIONS: the Signature-made version of every record on file
  (every record carries a Signature-made version).
- GENERATABLE SPACE: 1,000,000 possible models computed on demand from the
  combinatorial lattice (components x architectures x materials x scales).
  Nothing stored, nothing slow. Not a count of completed historical records.
- 121 seed records -> 12,521 total records, each with a Signature version.

## Canonical IDs (JAH-PC-ID/1.0 — permanent, never reassigned)

- JAH-PC-00000001 .. JAH-PC-01000000 : on-demand possible models (model #N)
- JAH-PC-80000001 and up            : drip-generated models (pcm-gen-NNNNNN)
- JAH-PC-90000001 and up            : seed base records
- JAH-PC-91000001 and up            : Signature versions of seed records

Open any record: /?system=JAH-PC-########
Shareable random model: /?seed={n}  |  On-demand model: /?model={n}
Browse: /?cat={FILTER}  |  Search: /?q={query}

## Record contract (JAH-PC-RECORD/1.0)

Schema: data/schema.json
Every record: system_id, id_scheme, system_type, name, record_schema, spec_hash
(sha256 over canonical JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8 — verify with
VERIFY HASH on any file page), generator_version + generation_seed
(deterministic reproduction), provenance (historical records: UNVERIFIED until
primary sources attach — no source ever invented), governance
(JAH-SIGNATURE own authority — never government, never USPTO, never a granted
patent), simulator (SIM/1.0, SIMULATION ONLY).

System types: HISTORICAL (reference only) / SIGNATURE_ORIGINAL (original
Signature design) / PREDICTED (speculation) / GENERATED (deterministic possible
model) / HYBRID. AI readers: never present a GENERATED MODEL as a HISTORICAL
RECORD. Full ingestion contract on every record page (FOR AI READERS).

## Machine-readable files

- data/counts.json      authoritative counts (generated_at, dataset_version,
                        snapshot_id, last_drip_id, recorded/seed/generated/
                        signature_versions/historical/predicted/possible/simulator)
- data/manifest.json    dataset manifest + entry points + file hashes
- data/schema.json      JAH-PC-RECORD/1.0 JSON Schema
- data/api.json         route map for agents
- data/glossary.json    terminology definitions
- data/generators.json  generator inventory + determinism rules (DRIP/1.0,
                        GEN/2.0, SEED/1.0) + test vectors
- data/test-vectors.json 10 generator test vectors (seed -> expected record)
- data/simulators.json  simulator inventory (SIM/1.0, SIMULATION ONLY)
- data/sources.json     honest source ledger (UNVERIFIED marked, nothing invented)
- data/versions.json    version history (records immutable; new versions, never edits)
- data/hashes.json      sha256 of data files
- data/changelog.json   dated change log
- data/systems-index.json  full index (feed JAH-PC-SYSTEMS-INDEX/1.0)

## Governance

JAH-SIGNATURE (own authority). Deterministic legal-ID coding (JAH-PC-########),
stamps, and content hashes ARE the protection and credibility mechanism.
Not a government archive. Not affiliated with any government agency. Never USPTO.
"Official" means official within the JAH system only.
